species.name: Lake trout
why: Water 41°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.
Best water today is 28–144 ft deep, mostly on open water over the deep basin.
The lake is mixed top to bottom, so fish can use many depths.

species.name: Trout
why: Water 41°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 38–42 ft deep, mostly on drop-offs.
The lake is mixed top to bottom, so fish can use many depths.

species.name: Northern pike
why: Water 41°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 12–24 ft deep, mostly on sheltered coves.
The lake is mixed top to bottom, so fish can use many depths.
Southwest wind at 9 mph pushes bait onto the northeast shore: try the wind-blown banks.
